query: SELECT kt.id FROM kitchen_tickets kt WHERE kt.branch_id = $1 AND kt.closed_at IS NULL AND kt.status <> 'voided' AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kitchen_ticket_items kti WHERE kti.kitchen_ticket_id = kt.id AND kti.voided_at IS NULL AND kti.bumped_at IS NULL AND kti.station_id = $2)) ORDER BY kt.created_at
